jobs.title: Associate Sales Enablement Manager
jobs.excerpt: We’re looking for an Associate Enablement Manager to support our Sales Development Representative (SDR) organization—the engine that drives our pipeline and fuels our growth.
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Associate Enablement Manager to support our Sales Development Representative (SDR) organization—the engine that drives our pipeline and fuels our growth. The SDR team is a fast-paced, high-volume environment where rapid skill acquisition, process discipline, and consistent execution are critical to success.

In this role, your superpower is execution and flawless organization. You will be responsible for managing multiple onboarding cohorts simultaneously, ensuring every new SDR is equipped with the tools, playbooks, and confidence they need to hit the ground running. Beyond onboarding, you will manage multiple enablement projects at once—from outbound sequencing updates to tech stack rollouts. As a strategic partner to SDR Leadership, Marketing, and Operations, you will translate process and strategy into highly structured, actionable training that accelerates ramp time and drives pipeline. This is a high-impact role with a clear growth path, including the opportunity to take ownership of major workstreams and scale into an Enablement Manager role.

What you’ll do

  • Manage Multi-Cohort Onboarding: Own the end-to-end execution of our SDR onboarding program, managing multiple overlapping cohorts at different stages of their ramp period without dropping the ball.

  • Drive Execution & Process: Build the foundational cold-calling, emailing, objection-handling, and qualification skills of SDRs so they can consistently book high-quality meetings.

  • Coordinate Concurrent Projects: Efficiently balance multiple enablement initiatives at once, ensuring project timelines for playbooks, campaigns, and tools are met seamlessly.

  • Create Structured Resources: Maintain, update, and deliver playbooks, talk tracks, sequence templates, and workflow guides that reinforce outbound and inbound best practices.

  • Optimize the Tech Stack: Train the team on maximizing efficiency within our SDR tech stack (e.g., Salesforce, Nooks, ZoomInfo) and track usage compliance.

  • Measure & Iterate: Leverage data, scorecards, and LMS metrics to track onboarding ramp times and identify areas for ongoing upskilling and programmatic improvement.

  • Facilitate High-Energy Training: Deliver engaging, structured group sessions, call blitzes, and roleplay workshops that build pipeline-generation momentum.

What you’ll need

  • Experience: BA/BS degree and 1–2 years of experience in sales enablement, as a high-performing SDR/BDR, or in a project management role within a B2B SaaS go-to-market function.

  • The "Execution" Superpower: Hyper-organized, detail-oriented, and project-disciplined. You have a proven track record of managing multiple complex projects or cohorts simultaneously with zero oversight.

  • SDR Savvy: Familiarity with modern inbound/outbound sales methodologies, sequencing strategy, cold calling, and pipeline generation.

  • Tech Stack Fluency: Quick learner with the ability to navigate and train others on tools like CRM (Salesforce), Sales Engagement Platforms and Conversational Intelligence

  • Communication & Facilitation: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable commanding a room, coaching competitive personalities, and running high-energy workshops.

  • Thrives in Speed: Comfortable in a high-volume, fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly and execution speed is a competitive advantage.

  • Action-Oriented: A proactive problem-solver with a strong bias toward action, execution, and driving absolute clarity out of ambiguity.

  • Adult Learning Foundations: An understanding of how to optimize training for adult learners, ensuring onboarding is interactive, practical, and execution-focused rather than purely theoretical.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. jobs.title: Marketing Assistant (Brand & Organic Marketing)
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.

About the role

﻿

Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.

You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.

What you will do

  • Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.
  • Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages—a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.
  • Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.
  • The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.
  • The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

  • Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.
  • Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.
  • A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.
  • B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.
  • Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.
  • Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).
  • Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.
  • Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.
  • A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

Disclosures:

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.

TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

jobs.excerpt: Our Company Empowering everyone to create.  Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life.
jobs.description:
Our Company

Empowering everyone to create.

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences.

We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Our Team

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

The Opportunity

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own design work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for an exceptionalSenior Multidisciplinary Designerto create beautifully crafted, culturally relevant work across Adobe Creative’s output.

You will work across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, motion and live experiences, moving confidently between early visual exploration, design development and polished final execution.

Working alongside Design leaders, Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Strategists and Product partners, you will help turn ideas into distinctive visual expressions that feel recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic.

You will combine exceptional design craft with curiosity for emerging technology. You will use Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled workflows to explore more widely, prototype more quickly and make stronger work without compromising taste, originality or human judgment.

You are a maker first. You care deeply about typography, image-making, composition, and the details that make an idea feel fully resolved.

What You’ll Do

Design Across the Work

  • Create high-quality design across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, and live experiences.

  • Develop work from early concept and visual exploration through design development and final execution.

  • Apply exceptional craft across typography, image-making, layout, composition and art direction.

  • Work across high-velocity everyday output and highly crafted flagship work.

  • Adapt strong ideas across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact.

  • Create work that feels connected and recognizably Adobe while remaining fresh, distinctive and culturally relevant.

Turn IdeasintoVisual Worlds

  • Partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors and Art Directors to develop visual territories and creative systems.

  • Translate campaign and creative ideas into compelling art direction and design expression.

  • Collaborate with Copywriters to develop visual and verbal ideas as one connected creative system.

  • Create mood boards, prototypes, and design studies that help teams explore and align early.

  • Know when to explore broadly and when to refine toward a clear, production-ready solution.

  • Bring a strong visual point of view while remaining open to collaboration and critique.

Build Scalable Creative Systems

  • Create modular frameworks, templates and reusable design tools that support speed without losing craft.

  • Help translate Adobe’s brand system into distinctive creative expression across real work.

  • Test how design ideas perform across channels, formats and audience needs.

  • Find opportunities to improve tools and workflows based on real creative applications.

  • Balance systematic thinking with experimentation, surprise and flexibility.

  • Document design thinking clearly so others can apply it effectively.

Advance AI-Native Design

  • Use Creative Cloud, Firefly and emerging generative tools throughout concepting, prototyping and production.

  • Use AI-enabled workflows to expand visual exploration and accelerate iteration without lowering the standard.

  • Apply human judgment, taste and craft to all AI-assisted work.

  • Help define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and intervention remain essential.

  • Test emerging Adobe capabilities through real creative work and share useful feedback with Product teams.

  • Apply responsible AI practices, including provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.

Collaborate and Deliver

  • Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Motion Designers, Strategists, Producers, Product and Product Marketing.

  • Present work clearly, explain design decisions, and respond constructively to feedback.

  • Partner with Production to carry ideas into execution while protecting their creative intent.

  • Collaborate with photographers, illustrators, artists, studios, and specialist partners whenrequired.

  • Maintain a high design standard through fast timelines, multiple workstreams, and changing priorities.

  • Take ownership of your work while contributing generously to the ideas and development of the wider team.

What You Need to Succeed

  • You consider yourself a maker first. AI fluency is how you work, not a skill you are developing.

  • 6+ years of experience in design, art direction, or multidisciplinary creative practice.

  • A standout portfolio demonstrating exceptional design craft across multi-platform campaigns and product storytelling.

  • Deep expertise in typography, layout, image-making, and visual composition.

  • Strong fluency across digital, motion, and emerging design practices.

  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to carry an idea from exploration through final execution.

  • Experience working across both high-velocity creative and highly crafted flagship work.

  • Experience applying brand systems in ways that feel distinctive and alive.

  • Strong systems thinking and experience creating modular frameworks, templates or reusable creative tools.

  • Fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled visual workflows.

  • A clear perspective on how generative AI changes visual exploration, authorship and production.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and collaborating with Copy, Motion, Strategy and Production.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, art, technology and emerging visual practices.

  • The ability to balance speed, experimentation, and craft.

  • A maker approach, curiosity and a commitment to continuously improving the work.


About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Position Purpose

Assist in financial analysis, pricing, and risk assessment to estimate outcomes. Support business decision-making through actuarial analysis, healthcare cost trend evaluation, and the identification of savings opportunities across healthcare data sources.

Key Details: This position is fully remote and can be performed from anywhere within the Continental United States. Candidates are required to have actuarial experience and demonstrated progress toward an actuarial credential through successful completion of actuarial exams. This role is part of Centene's Actuarial Development Program, offering exam support and professional development opportunities. Relevant experience includes healthcare analytics, cost trend analysis, medical claims analysis, working with large relational datasets, navigating varying levels of data granularity, and building actuarial models with clear, flexible assumptions and summarized outputs. Successful candidates will be able to communicate findings to project management, team leadership, and executive stakeholders.

  • Connect eligibility, revenue, claims, provider, and other healthcare data sources to identify and quantify savings opportunities through external partnerships and internal operational efficiencies.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly and effectively to project leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Work with large relational datasets and navigate varying levels of data granularity to appropriately consolidate and prepare key input data.
  • Build actuarial models with clear, flexible assumption inputs and summarized outputs.
  • Apply knowledge of mathematics, probability, statistics, principles of finance, and business to calculate financial outcomes.
  • Assist with developing probability tables based on analysis of statistical data and other pertinent information.
  • Analyze and evaluate required premium rates.
  • Assess cash reserves and liabilities to enable payment of future benefits.
  • Develop and run data reports.
  • Assist with determining an equitable basis for distributing money for insurance benefits.
  • Participate in merger and acquisition analysis.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Comply with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience. Combination of years of experience and number of actuarial exams passed equals or exceeds 5 (Rule of 5). For example, 2 years of actuarial experience and 3 passed actuarial exams.

Combination of years of experience and number of actuarial exams passed equals or exceeds 5 (Rule of 5). For example, 2 years of actuarial experience and 3 passed actuarial exams.

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

AlphaSense has spent more than a decade helping professionals find, trust, and synthesize market intelligence. With SuperAnalyst, we are expanding that foundation into continuous, decision-ready execution: workflows that monitor change, update outputs, and surface what matters as situations evolve. Mobile is a critical part of that future because the moments that matter do not only happen when customers are sitting at a desktop.

iOS is an important surface for that future because continuous, decision-ready workflows need to feel fast, secure, polished, and reliable across iPhone, iPad, and managed enterprise environments.

As a Staff iOS Engineer, you will own and evolve the iOS architecture and mobile-facing foundations that shape product quality across customer workflows. You will work from deep iOS expertise while shaping the technical decisions, validation practices, and delivery patterns that help teams build reliable native experiences with confidence.

This is a hands-on Staff role with significant architectural ownership, platform-level leverage, and long-term product impact. You will help teams move faster while improving delivery predictability and preserving the quality, reliability, and trust that enterprise mobile experiences require, including by shaping the AI-enabled development, validation, and testing practices that make iOS delivery safer and more confident.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and evolve the iOS platform foundation: Define the iOS architecture, modular boundaries, and native engineering patterns that make AlphaSense experiences fast, reliable, secure, and easier to evolve as the product grows.
  • Lead through hands-on iOS system design: Turn complex product and platform problems into durable production architecture grounded in deep iOS expertise and modern Apple platform practices.
  • Improve reliability and delivery confidence: Shape how iOS work is designed, reviewed, tested, shipped, and operated, including the automation, observability, rollout practices, and AI-enabled validation needed to move quickly with confidence.
  • Create clear mobile-facing system contracts: Partner with Android, backend, product, and design to clarify API behavior, ownership boundaries, and platform expectations that protect native product quality without pushing hidden complexity into iOS.
  • Raise mobile-system judgment across teams:Turn complex mobile-system work into reusable standards and stronger engineering judgment for the teams building native experiences..

What We´re looking for:

Required:

jobs.excerpt: If you are a passionate Full Stack Developer with expertise in Elixir, Phoenix and LiveView, and you're excited about revolutionizing the investment industry by crafting solutions for operational challenges and turning best practices into scalable, valuable products, Allocator One could be the perfect destination for your skills.
jobs.description:
If you are a passionate Full Stack Developer with expertise in Elixir, Phoenix and LiveView, and you're excited about revolutionizing the investment industry by crafting solutions for operational challenges and turning best practices into scalable, valuable products, Allocator One could be the perfect destination for your skills.

Come join our team where you'll play a crucial role in automating fund management and regulatory tasks, offering a transformative approach to the future of venture capital funds. You'll be working on all aspects of the application, from coding up user interfaces and components to building new endpoints or integrations. Our team has a good sense of humor and enjoys having fun. If you want to be part of this journey, keep reading!

We're on the lookout for individuals who've mastered either Elixir or React.js at a senior level, with at least a junior-level grasp of the other technology. If you're a senior pro in Ruby or Python and have a thirst for diving into Elixir, we're all ears and highly encourage you to apply.

As a member of our core team, you will work very closely with our founders, key stakeholders, and other experts. You will have the opportunity to learn from and contribute to the team's collective knowledge and expertise, and to participate in all aspects of the Allocator One value chain. The role will report into a Founding Partner.

Note: Allocator One is headquartered in Vienna, Austria. We offer the flexibility for this job to be performed remotely.

Allocator One

At Allocator One, we operate a distinctive fund model designed to invest in the most promising first-time fund managers worldwide while optimizing fees. With an eye on the highly favorable prospects for the 2023/2024 fund vintages, our team has accelerated its efforts to seize this unique opportunity. We pride ourselves on being the anchor investor of choice for exceptional first-time fund managers, offering them unparalleled access, expertise, and operational support.

Our focus on first-time fund managers

Allocator One's focus on first-time fund managers is driven by a simple yet compelling fact: historically, top-performing funds with assets under $50 million, led by emerging managers, have delivered returns that are more than 3 times higher over a 10-year horizon compared to their peers of larger fund sizes. Furthermore, the fund vintages of 2023/2024 in our pipeline are poised to enjoy an additional boost in returns. Venture capital funds that originate during economic recessions have consistently achieved returns that are 15%-30% higher compared to those raised in the preceding years, across various performance percentiles.

Optimizing fees and building Partnerships

We believe in optimizing fees while nurturing partnerships with first-time fund managers from the very beginning. Our aim is to enhance investment terms by actively contributing to the success of these funds. Allocator One has already established itself as a global brand in the realm of emerging managers, thanks to our extensive international investor network. In just two months since our launch, we've received over 300 applications, a testament to our commitment to supporting emerging talent. Our team goes beyond traditional investing; we offer to act as "co-builders," incorporating emerging managers into our unique Allocator One program, often likened to a "Y Combinator for Capital Allocators." We provide vital support in areas such as regulation, administration, and structure.

Our founding partners:

Our founders bring a wealth of experience and expertise to Allocator One:

  • Felix Staeritz: As the builder of category-leading corporate venture builder FoundersLane, Felix has an impressive track record of founding and exiting successful ventures. He is an active VC/PE investor and serves on the boards and advisory boards of esteemed organizations like the World Economic Forum (WEF), Fraunhofer, and various public and private companies.
  • Michael Ströck: Michael is a seasoned open source developer and entrepreneur with multiple successful exits to his name. He is an alumnus of Y Combinator and has transitioned from a CTO role to a successful investor. Michael has played a pivotal role in establishing three VC funds and is part of a family business now in its third generation.

Tasks

General responsibilities:

  • Implement new features on our web application
  • Solve complex programming challenges using functional programming languages (Elixir, in our case)
  • Develop new user-facing features using Elixir, Phoenix and LiveView
  • Build reusable components and front-end libraries for future use as specified by the UX team
  • Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality code integrated with the backend
  • Optimize components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers
  • Collaborate with the development team to develop a strategy that enables a great user experience
  • Continuously research new and best coding practices
  • Perform regular code reviews/PR reviews for your colleagues
  • Maintain existing code and fix bugs
  • Write unit, integration, and E2E tests

Requirements

Your skills and qualifications:

  • 5+ years of real-world experience in software development
  • Strong understanding of Elixir, Phoenix and LivewView in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of Elixir and LiveView
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Good understanding of modern front-end build pipelines and tools
  • Experience with common front-end development tools such as Babel, Webpack, NPM, etc.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements
  • Strong experience with HTML, CSS (we use Tailwind CSS ), and JavaScript
  • A strong desire to build beautiful end-user experiences that exceed expectation

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary
  • Potential for bonuses and equity
  • “No assholes allowed” company culture
  • Learn from and grow with experienced colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge

Hiring process:

Initial screen: This initial screen via video-call with a member of our team will be an opportunity for you to discuss your background and experience, and to ensure that you meet the minimum qualifications for the role and the job aligns with your expectations.

Interview with founding partners: If you are a strong candidate, you will be invited to participate in an interview with our founding partners. This will be an opportunity for you to learn more about the company's strategy and culture, and for the partners to get to know you better.

Case study and/or technical assessment during an work trial day: To get to know each other even better, we invite you to a work trial day, remotely. To assess your skills and knowledge, we may ask you to complete a case study or technical assessment.

After the final round interview, the team will review all of the candidates and make a decision on who to offer the position to. The hiring process can take several weeks, so please be patient as we review all of the applications and make a decision. If you are not selected for the role, we will notify you as soon as possible.

Sounds interesting? Then we look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

The Senior Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of Zayo's long haul fiber deployment portfolio through direct oversight of turnkey engineering and construction partners, cross-functional leadership, and governance of multiple concurrent, large-scale infrastructure programs. This role provides both strategic direction and operational execution across complex, multi-million-dollar network expansion initiatives.

The Senior Program Manager owns program governance, capital planning, contractor strategy, executive stakeholder alignment, risk management, and portfolio performance while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Zayo quality standards.

Serving as the primary operational and contractual interface between Zayo, engineering and construction partners, customers, and executive leadership, this position drives organizational alignment across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, GIS, and Network Planning to deliver critical network infrastructure at scale.

This role also leads continuous improvement initiatives, establishes deployment best practices, mentors program managers, and influences long-term deployment strategy across the Long Haul organization.

The Senior Program Manager reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

  • Own a portfolio of large-scale long haul deployment programs supporting strategic network expansion initiatives.

  • Develop portfolio delivery strategies aligned with company growth objectives and capital investment priorities.

  • Lead cross-functional planning from business case development through engineering, permitting, construction, testing, customer acceptance, and operational turnover.

  • Establish program governance, delivery standards, performance metrics, and executive reporting across multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Balance competing priorities, resources, and funding across multiple programs to optimize delivery performance.

  • Identify portfolio-level risks and dependencies and proactively implement mitigation and recovery strategies.

  • Provide recommendations to senior leadership regarding delivery strategy, capital allocation, contractor utilization, and execution priorities.

Executive Stakeholder Leadership

  • Serve as the executive operational lead for assigned deployment programs.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive leadership, customers, regulatory agencies, and strategic construction partners.

  • Lead executive steering committees, program reviews, and customer governance meetings.

  • Influence cross-functional decision making across Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and Network Planning.

  • Drive alignment between business objectives and deployment execution across multiple organizations.

Contractor Strategy & Vendor Performance

  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with turnkey engineering and construction partners.

  • Lead commercial negotiations for engineering and construction agreements, amendments, and complex change orders.

  • Establish contractor performance scorecards, KPIs, governance processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Evaluate contractor capacity, financial performance, safety metrics, production trends, and quality performance.

  • Drive executive-level performance reviews and corrective action plans when contractor performance falls below expectations.

  • Partner with Procurement and Legal to optimize sourcing strategies and improve contractor performance across the deployment portfolio.

Portfolio Financial Management

  • Own portfolio-level capital planning, forecasting, and financial performance.

  • Manage multi-million-dollar capital budgets across numerous concurrent deployment programs.

  • Lead financial forecasting, variance analysis, accrual management, and executive reporting.

  • Evaluate commercial impacts of scope changes, schedule adjustments, and risk events.

  • Partner with Finance to improve forecasting accuracy and optimize capital deployment.

  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, operational efficiencies, and improved return on investment.

Engineering, Regulatory & Deployment Governance

  • Provide strategic oversight of engineering, permitting, regulatory compliance, and construction execution.

  • Partner with Engineering leadership to improve constructability, deployment standards, and network design efficiency.

  • Oversee compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory requirements including NTIA, NEPA, Section 106, Tribal coordination, Davis-Bacon, BABA, and environmental obligations.

  • Ensure governance processes support quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and customer commitments across all assigned programs.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Lead initiatives to improve deployment processes, governance, reporting, and execution methodologies.

  • Develop standardized program management tools, dashboards, KPIs, and best practices.

  • Identify systemic risks and implement scalable operational improvements.

  • Leverage program data and performance metrics to improve forecasting accuracy, contractor productivity, and deployment efficiency.

  • Drive lessons learned across the organization to continuously improve delivery performance.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Mentor and develop Program Managers, Project Managers, and deployment personnel.

  • Provide guidance on complex delivery challenges, contractor management, financial controls, and executive communication.

  • Lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.

  • Support organizational planning, succession development, and capability building within the Long Haul Deployment organization.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, Business, or related field preferred.

  • Equivalent industry experience may be substituted for formal education.

  • At least ten (10) years of telecommunications, fiber deployment, infrastructure, or OSP program management experience.

  • At least eight (8) years leading complex outside plant construction programs and contractor organizations.

  • Demonstrated success leading portfolios of multimillion-dollar infrastructure deployments.

  • Experience managing EPC, engineering, and construction contracts.

  • Experience managing federally funded broadband programs and associated regulatory compliance.

  • Experience leading cross-functional organizations through complex delivery challenges.

  • Experience presenting to executive leadership and customer stakeholders.

  • Previous experience mentoring project managers or leading program management teams preferred.

  • PMP certification or equivalent program management certification preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Advanced knowledge of long haul fiber architecture, OSP engineering, and construction practices.

  • Expert understanding of capital project controls, forecasting, earned value principles, and financial reporting.

  • Strong knowledge of permitting, environmental compliance, and federal broadband funding requirements.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, dashboards, pivot tables, Power Query, and executive reporting.

  • Working knowledge of GIS platforms, network inventory systems, Salesforce, Sitetracker, and project portfolio management tools.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, fiber testing documentation, route designs, and construction packages.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with the ability to balance long-term objectives and near-term execution.

  • Executive presence and communication skills.

  • Strong influence without formal authority.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management.

  • Portfolio and program governance.

  • Financial and commercial acumen.

  • Contract negotiation and supplier management.

  • Operational excellence and continuous improvement mindset.

  • Data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent judgment in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.

  • Ability to lead multiple complex programs simultaneously.

Estimated base salary range: $95,100 - $146,300 USD/annually.

Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. jobs.excerpt: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide.
jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


About the Role

Beckett is the trusted authority in sports card and collectibles grading, pricing, and marketplace services. Our technology organization is in the middle of an exciting modernization: we're rebuilding our platform as a fleet of TypeScript microservices and modern Next.js frontends while responsibly operating and incrementally extracting the legacy systems that still power core revenue.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you are the engine of your team. You own meaningful features end to end — from design through production — across a large share of your team's products, and you work independently on efforts spanning multiple sprints. You raise the bar for the engineers around you through code review, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.

What You'll Do

Build and ship

  • Design and deliver production-ready, easily testable, and understandable solutions that account for known and potential edge cases — across a large number of your team's products, not just a single service.

  • Develop backend services in NestJS 11 / TypeScript with TypeORM and PostgreSQL, and frontend features in Next.js / React 18–19.

  • Contribute to the modernization effort: help replace legacy Java 21 / Spring Boot services and carve functionality out of our PHP monolith into well-bounded modern services.

  • Apply appropriate security, testing (unit, integration, Cypress E2E), documentation, and monitoring best practices as a matter of course.

  • Deploy and operate your services on AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS) using Docker and infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK in TypeScript, some Terraform), with CI/CD through CodeBuild.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as a core part of your daily workflow — for code generation, refactoring, test authoring, and navigating unfamiliar legacy code — while applying senior-level judgment to review, verify, and own everything you ship.

Execute and deliver

  • Consistently drive larger sets of changes to completion across 2+ sprint efforts.

  • Commit to a realistic amount of work, anticipate blockers and delays proactively, and clarify expectations with stakeholders before problems land on the team.

  • Right-size your own work using a value-vs-cost mindset and help teammates do the same.

Lift the team

  • Recognize and seize opportunities to share knowledge — tech talks, documentation, design reviews — and encourage others to do the same, including effective AI-tool workflows, prompts, and patterns you've developed.

  • Onboard new engineers and volunteer for team-wide responsibilities (on-call improvements, tooling, quality initiatives).

  • Deliver praise and constructive feedback to teammates and your manager, and incorporate feedback in the spirit of continuous learning.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production full-stack web applications — you're comfortable owning a feature from the database schema through the API to the rendered UI.

  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js (we use NestJS and Express) or deep experience in Java/Spring Boot with strong motivation to work in TypeScript.

  • Strong relational database skills (PostgreSQL and/or MySQL): schema design, query optimization, and ORM usage (TypeORM, Sequelize, or similar).

  • Proven frontend engineering experience with React (Next.js strongly preferred): component architecture, state management (e.g., Redux or React Query), SSR/ISR, accessibility, and frontend performance.

  • Experience designing and consuming APIs across the stack (REST required; GraphQL a plus), including auth, pagination, and error-handling patterns that hold up in production.

  • Solid grounding in automated testing and CI/CD; you treat tests and observability as part of the definition of done.

  • Experience with AWS and containerized deployment (Docker).

  • Ability to work independently on multi-sprint efforts: you scope, design, communicate, and ship without needing day-to-day direction.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI developer tooling: hands-on, day-to-day experience using AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate delivery — and the discipline to validate AI-generated code with tests, review, and a clear understanding of what it does.

Nice to Have

  • Experience modernizing or strangling legacy systems (PHP/CodeIgniter, older Java, or .NET Framework).

  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (AWS CDK or Terraform).

  • Familiarity with message-driven architectures (SQS), GraphQL, gRPC, or headless CMS (Strapi).

  • Experience with React Native/Expo mobile development, or Python (FastAPI, data pipelines).

  • Experience building with LLMs, not just using them: LLM API integration (Anthropic/OpenAI), retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, or agentic workflows (e.g., MCP).

  • Interest in sports cards, gaming, or collectibles!

Client Success Associate - New Client Engagement

Remote US based Opportunity

About the role:

The Client Success team follows a Client for Life Philosophy, and individuals in this role ensure that every Gartner client receives value far exceeding their investment. Associates seek to understand and surface client’s business priorities, breakdown challenges, and identify the most effective ways to support the client in making the right decisions for their business. They are responsible for articulating Gartner value to prospective clients, onboarding clients, proving the concept of Gartner services, and stimulating client engagement of products.

New Client Engagement (NCE), a part of our Client Success Organization, is a fast-paced, dynamic business unit focused on providing the highest level of service to prospects and clients. NCE is made up of two functions: Client Onboarding and Insights Platform Walkthrough for prospects.

The Client Onboarding role focuses on providing a customized experience for new and upgraded clients. The Insights Platform Walkthrough team provides pre-sale demonstrations of Gartner resources, including our gartner.com platform, to prospects as a part of the sales process. 

The NCE team utilizes Gartner assets, coupled with our gartner.com platform, to provide a valuable client experience that starts with a prospect demonstration by an NCE Insights Platform Walkthrough specialist, moves to an extensive client onboarding experience by an NCE Client Onboarding Specialist and transitions seamlessly to a service delivery associate for ongoing support. 

You’ll apply strategic thinking and relationship building to help executives solve their most pressing business challenges. You will understand their critical initiatives, align Gartner research and expertise, and help contribute to Gartner’s growth.

What you will do:

  • Lead prospect and/or client calls to understand client priorities and challenges and articulate the value of Gartner’s renowned products and services. Understand and communicate Gartner services and capabilities to prospective clients and demonstrate value to decision makers.

  • Collaborate with our Sales teams on how to effectively demonstrate Gartner products and resources to prospects or clients to increase likelihood of engaging and purchasing a license. Communicate with internal Gartner partners to overcome obstacles and maximize the value Gartner delivers to prospects and clients.

  • Research prospective and existing companies, C-Level executives, business trends, and competitive intelligence to prepare relevant and tailored Gartner resources to drive impact.

What you will need:

  • English and Portuguese language proficiency

  • 6+ months relevant professional and/or internship experience with a proven track record of success fueled by a passion for driving client success.

  • Ability to demonstrate strong communication, collaboration, prioritization, critical thinking, and influencing skills; ability to be agile and flexible

  • Well defined time management and organizational skills

  • Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

CAPABILITY / JOB FAMILY GROUP: Artificial Intelligence

JOB FAMILY: AI Engineering

JOB PROFILE TITLE: AI Solution Architect

MANAGEMENT LEVEL: Manager

JOB PROFILE DESCRIPTION

As an AI Solution Architect in Actonomy, you’ll be the technical lead on our customer-facing Frontier AI projects, responsible for the successful delivery of high quality AI solutions built on Actonomy’s products. You’ll lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers working hands-on inside customer environments to turn ambitious AI ideas into production reality. It’s a role that combines engineering, consulting and product thinking, so you’ll be as comfortable in front of a customer as you are in the code.

As a technical leader, you’ll work with senior stakeholders to agree architectural principles and strategic direction, develop customer relationships and account management, and feed what you learn on the ground back into our product direction. You’ll manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on performance and career development, whilst advising on new technologies and approaches to AI and helping the people around you learn, develop and grow.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading Frontier AI projects – You’ll be the technical lead on customer engagements, owning the solution end to end and guiding a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver it.

  • Working directly with customers – You’ll work with customers and senior stakeholders to understand their business problems and desired outcomes, and agree architectural principles and strategic direction.

  • Deploying and integrating – You’ll oversee the deployment, configuration and integration of Actonomy’s products within customer environments, and resolve the technical challenges that arise during rollout.

  • Leading your team – You’ll provide technical direction, support and line management to a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, helping them make the right decisions and grow.

  • Closing the product loop – You’ll gather user feedback and translate customer needs into product improvements, working closely with our Product and Engineering teams.

  • Building reusable assets – You’ll create reusable deployment patterns and implementation assets that make each engagement faster and better than the last.

  • Driving adoption and value – You’ll support customer adoption and value-realisation activities so customers get real, lasting value from AI in their day-to-day work.

  • Staying at the frontier – You’ll stay current with developments in AI, Microsoft technologies and the Actonomy platform, and share that knowledge with your team and customers.

MINIMUM (ESSENTIAL) REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven experience leading the delivery of production AI solutions across different sizes and shapes of challenge (e.g. an AI service, a multi-team programme, a customer platform deployment or a complex integration).

  • Experience acting as the technical lead on customer-facing projects, ideally deploying software products or platforms within customer environments.

  • Significant hands-on experience with Python and public cloud platforms, particularly Azure, including SaaS and PaaS offerings.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying with modern AI, including large language models and agentic AI (prompt engineering, RAG, tool and function calling, orchestration), on the Microsoft AI stack such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI services.

  • Proven experience of technical ownership for an AI product or software project, including architecture, estimation, product planning and user story/requirement creation.

  • Able to understand whole-solution architecture and to communicate and negotiate it with senior and C-level stakeholders, including the commercial implications of design decisions.

  • Able to simplify and clearly communicate AI design in conversation, documentation and presentations to non-engineers. Comfortable working directly with customers and users, developing relationships and supporting account management.

  • Experience integrating products or solutions with customer systems and data sources and resolving technical issues during implementation and rollout.

  • Able to prioritise across multiple major projects, particularly when working to deadlines.

  • A demonstrated ability in managing, mentoring, coaching and developing members of your team and the wider community, including managing a small number of staff.

DESIRABLE

  • Experience with React or similar technologies.

  • Familiarity with the Microsoft agent ecosystem.

  • Experience creating reusable deployment patterns and implementation assets.

  • Experience working in consulting, customer-facing or delivery roles.

  • Awareness of responsible AI and AI evaluation practices.

  • Active participation in technology communities and knowledge sharing, internally and externally.

WHO YOU ARE

Our vision is to enable outstanding people to create digital solutions that have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our values aren’t abstract; they are the behaviours we expect from each other every day and underpin everything that we do. We expect everyone to display our values by being determined in how obstacles are overcome; honest when dealing with others; respectful of how you treat others; creative to find solutions to complex problems and cooperative by sharing information, knowledge and experience.

These values, applied collectively, help to produce an outstanding Kainos person, team and culture.

ABOUT US

Actonomy is a Kainos team focused on developing innovative AI products that solve real problems and create meaningful impact. We bring together deep technical expertise and a passion for AI to build intelligent, agentic solutions on the Azure stack.

We work at the frontier of what’s possible with AI – exploring new architectures, pushing platform boundaries and building products that make people’s working lives better.

As part of Kainos, we benefit from a culture built on collaboration, continuous learning and doing the right thing. For more information, see kainos.com

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

The Automotive Training Institute (ATI), the largest coaching and training company for Owners of Independent Repair Shops in the US and Canada. With over 1700 shops actively engaged in our program, we provide coaching, training and the largest buying program in the automotive aftermarket for Independent Shop Owners. Our members have cumulatively increased their Gross Profits by almost $3.0 Billion dollars through the ATI program.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

ATI’s 24 Fundamentals describe the values, behaviors, principles, and practices that are the foundation of our unique culture. It explains how we relate to each other, our members, and even our suppliers. It’s who we are, and it’s what drives our extraordinary success.

Position Summary

Provide an analysis of the existing practices of a member’s automotive shop and make recommendations for improvements based on ATI’s best practices and techniques. Provide coaching, consultation, and mentoring to our members in order for them to achieve the business goals and dreams. Guide members through the building blocks that turn their automotive shop into a profitable and efficient business via our 48-­month re­engineering program and alumni programs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Listen, including active listening, to the needs of the shop owners to help them turn their shop into a profitable and efficient business.

  • Communicate for understanding what members wish to improve or correct about their business via phone, zoom and email.

  • Review financial statements, evaluate competitors and analyze business practices.

  • Once research is complete, Coach will develop a new business model or prepare recommendations and present them to the client.

  • Display a professional but assertive and results-oriented, approach with strong mentoring skills and a passion for helping shop owners to become successful business owners.

  • It is vital that your background includes management in the automotive aftermarket arena ideally in an independent repair shop, or a MSO group of repair shops.

  • It is also important that you display excellent communication, interpersonal, and persuasion skills, as well as the ability to convince business owners to make major changes and paradigm shifts in their practices especially via phone or videoconferencing.

  • To Consult, Train, Mentor and Coach a client to help them achieve their business goals and dreams.

  • To successfully guide the client through the building blocks that creates the foundation of a profitable business.

  • To meet or exceed all ATI goals;

  • Return on Investment for the client

  • CSI Scores, maintain customer’s satisfaction in the program

  • Report Cards/Road Map to monitor and measure performance and progress

  • Alumni conversation rate

  • Weekly contact with the Client

  • Ensure class attendance by the client and staff

  • Monitor status of where member is in the program at all times and determine how we can best align the member’s needs with their wants

Administrative Duties:

  • Startup Agreement paperwork, Coach Client agreement, enter clear and understandable weekly notes based on client/coach calls

  • Provide research and content for articles, classroom and training material, Participation in weekly Coaches meetings, be aware of trends in other service-related industries that we could adapt or apply

  • Attend Shop Owner’s Dinner Events, annual SuperConference participation and industry related events.

  • Required to attend monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual company meetings.

  • Be prepared for and participate in weekly One on Ones with Team Leaders, participate in all Company meetings.

  • Attend ATI classes quarterly

  • Facilitate an ATI Peer group or Performance group

  • Participate in other modalities such as Live @ 9, podcasts, owner events, industry presentations and tradeshows

  • Be responsible for your calendar and manage time efficiently

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years overall automotive experience with a strong focus in service writing, shop management, operations management, or previous shop ownership, preferably in the independent, non­dealer, aftermarket arena

  • Operations management experience (preferably with an aftermarket chain) involving established internal structure and processes

  • Exceptional coaching and mentoring skills

  • Solid automotive business understanding

  • Ability to influence others over the telephone and videoconferencing

  • Minimum 4 years of teaching, instructing, and mentoring small business owners or employees, with a clear understanding of the challenges facing independent shop owners

  • Track record of consultative management, people development, and business management prior experience and success working in an organization that provides monthly goals Computer proficiency, particularly in Word and Excel; Knowledge of SalesForce CRM, a plus Sales abilities, strongly preferred

  • Accounting or P&L experience

  • Marketing and online/social media experience.

  • Writing skills with an interest in writing articles for industry magazines, a plus

  • Solid understanding of how to recruit and retain high quality employees at all levels of experience

  • It is also important that you display excellent communication, interpersonal, and persuasion skills, as well as the ability to convince business owners to make major changes and paradigm shifts in their practices. This does include maintaining an appropriate and professional personal image.

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Data Operations Support Lead will lead the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team in delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/ Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will oversee the daily operational health of data pipelines, platforms, and governance processes within the CMM Data Modernization and Governance program. This role leads a team responsible for monitoring data flows, triaging and resolving data incidents, enforcing data quality and governance standards in production, and ensuring reliable, well-documented data operations across the program's workstreams. The ideal candidate combines hands-on data operations experience with team leadership skills and is comfortable acting as the operational point of escalation between technical teams, governance stakeholders, and business users.

The Data Operations Support Lead will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary contract liaison, ensuring execution aligns with strategic goals and overseeing daily operational matters.
  • Lead daily operations for CMM data platforms, pipelines, integrations, applications, analytics environments, and data products.
  • Establish and manage procedures for monitoring, incident response, problem management, service requests, maintenance, and releases.
  • Monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, and pipeline health against SLAs; resolve critical incidents and conduct root‑cause analysis.
  • Coordinate production support across cloud, data engineering, application, BI/analytics, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, escalation paths, and system documentation.
  • Manage RAID logs and perform risk identification, communication, and mitigation.
  • Oversee operational performance of ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, CDC processes, integrations, data lakes, and warehouses; address pipeline failures and data quality issues.
  • Support cloud data platforms in AWS, including analytics and AI/ML services; coordinate upgrades, patching, and environment management.
  • Support capacity planning, performance tuning, resilience, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Partner with Data Governance/Data Engineering to operationalize data quality rules, metadata, lineage, and stewardship processes.
  • Monitor and remediate data quality exceptions, operational risks, and audit findings.
  • Promote automation for monitoring, deployments, testing, incident response, and operational reporting; support CI/CD, IaC, observability, and SRE best practices.
  • Build dashboards and metrics for availability, performance, pipeline health, data quality, and incident trends; identify reliability and efficiency improvements.
  • Lead incident management for high‑priority issues, coordinate escalations, and facilitate post‑incident reviews.
  • Support change and release management; assess operational impacts of architecture, application, data, and platform changes.
  • Lead Data Operations personnel, assign priorities, ensure objectives are met, and mentor team members on operational best practices.
  • Continuously improve the CMM Data Operations operating model and provide transparent reporting on progress, risks, financials, and outcomes.
  • Provide COR and government leadership with analysis, research, alternatives, and solution/design recommendations upon request.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years’ experience in IT Management including technology solutions delivery with emphasis on data governance strategy, standards development, implementation, operation support, and change management services to accelerate modernization efforts.
  • The Task Lead must possess bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
  • The Program Manager must possess a Project Management Professional Certification (PMP).
  • Expertise in overseeing teams dedicated to big data cloud solution architecture, cybersecurity, data management, business intelligence and analytics.
  • Excellent customer-facing skills with experience briefing senior executive leadership.
  • Experience operating or supporting master data management (MDM) platforms or enterprise data governance tooling.
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK) and regulatory/compliance considerations related to data privacy and security.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent experience with IT service management practices.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data platform migrations or modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to streamline monitoring and operational tasks.
  • Experience with data observability or monitoring platforms (e.g., Monte Carlo, Collibra, Informatica).

jobs.description:
About 10a Labs: 10a Labs is the safety and threat-intelligence layer trusted by frontier AI labs, AI unicorns, Fortune 10 companies, and leading global technology platforms. Our adversarial red teaming, model evaluations, and intelligence collection enable engineering, safety, and security teams to stay ahead of evolving threats and deploy AI systems safely.

About the Role

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and evaluate advanced machine learning systems across AI safety and model evaluation applications.

This role combines strong ML engineering with an experimental mindset. You will work on problems involving reinforcement learning, model evaluations, language models,multimodal systems, and classifiers, taking ambiguous technical questions and turning them into rigorous experiments and scalable systems.

You will collaborate closely with engineers, analysts, red teamers, and subject-matter experts supporting leading AI organizations.

What You'll Do

  • Design and run ML experiments to evaluate the capabilities, behavior, robustness, and limitations of advanced AI systems.
  • Develop and evaluate models acrossreinforcement learning, NLP/LLMs, computer vision, and multimodal ML.
  • Build evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, datasets, and metrics for frontier AI systems.
  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models for safety, security, and other high-impact applications.
  • Develop reliable tooling and infrastructure to run ML experiments and evaluations at scale.
  • Analyze results, identify model failure modes, and translate findings into new experiments and technical approaches.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of experience in machine learning, research engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating modern ML models.
  • Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, and quantitative analysis.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI fundamentals, including common harnesses, Model Context Protocol, agent benchmarks, and security risks to AI agents.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: reinforcement learning, NLP/LLMs, computer vision, or multimodal ML.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to work independently on ambiguous technical problems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, policy optimization, or other model post-training techniques.
  • Experience evaluating frontier language or multimodal models.
  • Experience with adversarial evaluations, robustness testing, or AI safety.
  • Experience with distributed training, cloud ML infrastructure, or large-scale ML systems.

We don't expect candidates to have experience across every area above. We value deep ML expertise, strong experimental instincts, and the ability to quickly learn new techniques.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: $130K–$200K, depending on experience and location
  • Bonus: Performance-based annual bonus
  • Professional Development: Support for conferences, continuing education, or leadership training
  • Work Environment: Fully remote, U.S.-based
  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Time Off: Generous PTO and paid holiday schedule

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.
