About US:-

We turn customer challenges into growth opportunities.

Material is a global strategy partner to the world’s most recognizable brands and innovative companies. Our people around the globe thrive by helping organizations design and deliver rewarding customer experiences.

We use deep human insights, design innovation and data to create experiences powered by modern technology. Our approaches speed engagement and growth for the companies we work with and transform relationships between businesses and the people they serve.

Srijan, a Material company, is a renowned global digital engineering firm with a reputation for solving complex technology problems using their deep technology expertise and leveraging strategic partnerships with top-tier technology partners. Be a part of an Awesome Tribe

ROLE SUMMARY

We’re looking for a hands-on Agentic AI Engineer to build, optimize, and deploy production-grade AI solutions. In this role, you will be the engine room of our AI initiatives — taking architectural blueprints and turning them into scalable, functional systems. You will work across the full build lifecycle — from prototyping to production — collaborating with Senior Architects and data scientists to deliver AI solutions in a consulting environment.

Role: Agentic AI Engineer

Experience: 3+ years

Employment Type: Full-time

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Agentic Development

  • Build: Develop LLM-based applications and multi-step agentic workflows using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, AutoGen, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI

  • RAG Pipelines: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines: chunking, embedding, vector search, and re-ranking

  • Tool Use & Memory: Build agents with tool-calling, short/long-term memory, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints

  • Prompt Engineering: Design and iterate on system prompts, chain-of-thought templates, and structured output schemas

  • Model Fine-tuning: Execute fine-tuning and optimization tasks (Quantization, PEFT/LoRA) to adapt foundation models for specific domain tasks

Integration & Delivery

  • APIs: Expose AI capabilities via FastAPI endpoints; integrate with client data sources and third-party APIs

  • Vector Databases: Manage embeddings and retrieval using Pinecone, Qdrant, or pgvector

MLOps & Productionization

  • Deployment: Containerize and deploy AI services using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS / Azure cloud environments, ensuring high availability and low latency

  • Observability: Implement observability for AI systems using LangSmith or Arize Phoenix, tracking accuracy, hallucinations, cost, and latency

  • CI/CD: Maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML, ensuring automated testing (unit, contract, and model-quality tests) is integrated into the delivery workflow

  • Guardrails & Hallucination Control: Apply output validation, guardrails, and hallucination-detection techniques to ensure reliable, production-safe AI outputs

  • Token Optimization: Apply prompt compression, context window management, and response caching to control inference cost and latency

Collaboration

  • Client Delivery: Work closely with Senior Architects and Engagement Managers to translate business requirements into technical tasks and working solutions

  • Code Quality: Write clean, modular Python; participate in peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s internal library of reusable AI patterns and playbooks

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 3+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or ML; at least 1 year building LLM/Gen AI applications

  • Python: Strong Python skills — OOP, async programming, packaging, and testing

  • LLM Frameworks: Hands-on experience with at least one of: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or LlamaIndex

  • Gen AI: Working knowledge of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini) and prompt design

  • Cloud Basics: Familiarity with AWS or Azure; comfortable with REST APIs and Git-based workflows

  • MLOps & Productionization: Hands-on experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI systems in production — Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling are non-negotiable

  • Engineering Fundamentals: Solid SQL skills, API design experience (FastAPI/Flask), and a “software engineering first” approach to ML — encompassing testing, modularity, and documentation

  • Education: B.Tech / B.E. / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

GOOD TO HAVE

  • Evaluation: Exposure to G-Eval, RAGAS, TruLens, or LangSmith for quantifying LLM output quality

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. At Samsara, we believe our people are our greatest investment, and hiring is a critical part of our success. We’re looking for a talented Recruiter to partner closely with our growing GTM teams to build a strong pipeline of top-tier candidates.   • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.


In this role, you will:

  • Manage Full-Cycle Recruiting: Create and implement strategies to solve problems and build diverse pipelines across Samsara’s corporate teams through sourcing, referrals, research, events, and social media. Find and engage passive candidates through creative sourcing techniques and help them envision life at Samsara. Effectively manage multiple requisitions and candidates during high-volume periods while creating and owning a flawlessly positive candidate experience
  • Be a Talent Advisor: Partner closely with hiring leaders to deeply understand their teams and goals. Organize and facilitate interview debriefs and drive offer approval, extension, and negotiation. Identify closing strategies for offers and proactively provide candidates with the appropriate information to help make their decision as easy as possible
  • Influence with data: Independently address and unblock data analysis challenges. Extract and synthesize insights. Identify headwinds and tailwinds with a search.

  • Be a Diversity Advocate: Develop and implement sourcing strategies and marketing programs to identify top talent and build diverse candidate pipelines. Advise on structured interview processes that mitigate unconscious bias. Coach leaders and interviewers in inclusive interviewing best practices and objective feedback.
  • Process Excellence: Track pipeline data and provide relevant and consistent updates to hiring managers. Maintain high attention to detail when entering data into Greenhouse and other recruiting tools
  • Be a Cultural Champion: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 4+ years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to create, measure, and scale the right workflow between candidates, hiring managers, and the recruiting team
  • Proven strategic sourcing skills
  • Team player with an eye for talent who loves connecting people and opportunities
  • Able to confidently represent Samsara with professionalism both internally and externally
  • Target-driven, detail-oriented, approachable, and able to bring up others around you
  • Previous tech experience preferred, and an unwavering ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Familiarity with Greenhouse or equivalent ATS experience
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience

Benefits

Working at Samsara has its perks: for all global employees, we provide private medical and dental insurance plus growth and development opportunities, as well as regular virtual team and company events. In the US we offer flexible vacation time, EMEA employees receive 25 vacation days plus national bank holidays. Post-COVID we’ll be back in our global offices with numerous in-office perks.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$86,275—$145,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. About Kintsugi

Kintsugi is the AI-powered sales tax automation platform built for SaaS and ecommerce businesses. We handle the parts of sales tax compliance that used to eat up a finance team's week, nexus tracking, registrations, filings, and audits, so our customers can focus on growing their business instead of chasing tax logic.

About the Role

A Digital Customer Success Associate manages a large volume of customer accounts using automation, data, and digital programs instead of traditional one-on-one phone calls and meetings.

That's exactly what this role is. The Digital Customer Success Associate at Kintsugi owns the relationship with our Growth segment customers from the moment Onboarding hands them off. This is a high-volume, tech-touch role. Each Digital Customer Success Associate manages a book of 200 to 250 Growth accounts and is responsible for keeping those accounts healthy, renewing, and out of the escalation queue. Success in this role isn't about answering every ticket that comes in. It's about using our admin panel and tooling to spot risk early and get ahead of a problem before the customer ever has to raise their hand.

This is a great fit for someone who wants real ownership over a large book of business and is energized by the pace and problem-solving of a startup.

Responsibilities & Expectations

  • Own the post-onboarding relationship for 200 to 250 Growth-tier accounts as the customer's main point of contact for account health, retention, and renewal.

  • Drive retention and renewal rates across the book. Proactively spot at-risk accounts and step in before they churn, not after.

  • Monitor account health using the admin panel and CS tooling: login and usage activity, filing cadence, collected-vs-calculated tax variance, and integration status. Catch issues before they surface as a support ticket or a churn conversation.

  • Validate ongoing account data quality, including addresses, product classification, and integration data flow.

  • Act as the escalation point for account issues, pulling in Support, Product, or Engineering when something needs to get fixed at the root.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales on renewals and expansion, Finance on billing and plan questions, and Product/Engineering on recurring issues affecting the portfolio.

  • Surface patterns to leadership, not just individual tickets: recurring product gaps, process breakdowns, and anything that points to a bigger fix.

  • Manage a high-volume queue without losing track of individual accounts. Triage and prioritize across the full book every day.

  • Keep account records and communication history current across our CS tools (admin panel, DevRev, HubSpot, Gainsight/ChurnZero, Jira) so the whole team has visibility.

  • Help build and refine the playbooks that let one person support 200+ accounts well: health scoring, automated outreach triggers, self-serve content.

Qualifications

Required

  • 1 to 2 years in a customer-facing retention role, ideally managing a high-volume book (100+ accounts).

  • A track record of moving retention and renewal numbers, not just reporting on them.

  • Comfortable working across several tools at once to manage a large portfolio efficiently.

  • Strong English written and verbal communication. Able to turn a technical or product issue into a clear customer conversation.

  • A cross-functional collaborator who works well with Sales, Finance, and Product/Engineering to get things resolved.

  • A self-starter with a bias for action. Identifies issues and brings them to leadership without waiting to be asked.

  • Startup mentality: hungry, resourceful, and moves fast.

Preferred

  • Experience with DevRev, HubSpot, Gainsight, ChurnZero, and/or Jira.

  • Background in SaaS, fintech, or tax/compliance.

About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with understanding of Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms or systems programming

  • Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and proficiency in Go (secondary).

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • APIs & Serialization: gRPC/Protobuf contract design (via tonic/prost) and schema evolution (using zero-copy serialization and compile-time type generation).

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external service dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Desired:

  • Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

  • Demonstrated participation or maintaining open-source systems projects

What does Mirantis offer you?

- Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
- Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
- Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;

jobs.description:
ORCID is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic professional for the position of fully remote Engagement Lead. If you like the flexibility of a remote organization and the public-service orientation of a non-profit, join us on our mission to connect research and researchers!

The Role

ORCID is seeking an Engagement Lead to drive community growth, membership, and product adoption within North America. The role focuses on fostering member relationships, managing new membership development, and ensuring member success to support ORCID's sustainability, mission, and core strategies.

The position will be part of our Engagement team, reporting to the Director of Engagement and is full time (40 hours/week).

Like all positions at ORCID, the role is fully remote. Candidates must be able to work during eastern US standard business hours (Mon-Fri) with at least four hours daily between 9:00 AM-2:00 PM ET, with some recurring meetings between 10:00 AM-1:00 PM ET. Outside of these parameters, ORCID offers flexibility with your schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Member Engagement & Growth
    • Foster and manage relationships with members and stakeholders in assigned segments in North America to ensure renewals.
    • New membership development: Identify, develop, and close new membership opportunities.
    • Integration development: Increase the depth, number and diversity of integrations to improve data contribution.
    • Member support: Coordinate and execute member support requests in collaboration with other ORCID staff where relevant, to ensure high member satisfaction and value.
    • Consortium Lead engagement: Coordinate and align with assigned Consortium Lead organizations through regular meetings and strategic planning, to advance ORCID’s mission, grow memberships, and increase adoption, ensuring a consistently collaborative approach.
    • Advise your manager on strategic opportunities & direction: Provide insights and recommendations related to your assigned members and region(s), to inform strategic decision making.
  • Community Building & Outreach
    • Fostering the core values of ORCID: Build global "communities of practice" within your assigned segments and/or regions.
    • Events strategy and outreach coordination: Assist in defining and executing outreach initiatives, collaborating with various ORCID teams as needed.
    • Events participation: Present and represent ORCID at in-person and virtual events where needed, manage travel and administration as required, and handle abstract submission and application processes where needed
  • Operational Excellence & Collaboration
    • Process Management: Consistently follow and execute on defined processes and procedures. Actively contribute to identifying opportunities for process improvement and collaborate with colleagues to enhance operational efficiency.
    • "One ORCID team": Actively cooperate with and inform colleagues to foster transparency, collaboration, and achieve the best outcomes for the organization.
    • Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in cross-team initiatives and projects, collaborating with colleagues in other ORCID teams as needed to support shared goals.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience in a consultative business development, account management or externally facing product-related role
  • Proven track record in developing and maintaining new organizational relationships
  • 2+ plus years of experience working with the Scholarly Community, ideally within open research or open scholarly infrastructure
  • Experience setting, coordinating and achieving strategic goals with external partners
  • Experience working and engaging in global, multicultural, and virtual team environments
  • Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills
  • Knowledge of CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce)
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and balance competing priorities
  • Fluency in English. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to travel based upon business needs (less than 25%)

To Apply: Please submit your CV and a cover letter via Bamboo. In your cover letter, outline how your experience aligns with the roles and responsibilities of this position. ORCID encourages applicants who meet some, but not all of the requirements and qualifications, to apply.

Who We Are

ORCID is a mission-driven, member-supported, community-governed non-profit organization. Our vision is a world where all who participate in research, scholarship, and innovation are uniquely identified and connected to their contributions across disciplines, borders, and time. Every one of ORCID’s employees is committed to that vision as well.

We believe in and operate by our three values. ORCID strives to be:

  • Inclusive: We make decisions collaboratively, involving our staff, Board, those who support our mission, and the researchers and community that are the purpose of our work. We take a global view.
  • Trusted: Privacy and researcher control underscores everything we do.
  • Open: Our work is open, transparent, and non-proprietary.

Where We’re Located

As a fully-remote organization serving researchers everywhere, ORCID is able to hire talented individuals all over the globe, and we aim to have our people located in the communities that we serve. For this position, we are focusing on people located in the United States.

Our Culture

ORCID has been a global, 100% remote organization since our founding in 2012. This has enabled us to build a team of the best and brightest minds in the industry. ORCID staff are curious and collaborative, and we strive to maintain a culture of learning. We offer programs like individually-focused professional development planning, monthly “Food for Thought” learning sessions on a wide variety of topics, and access to a digital learning platform, Udemy for Business. We are flexible and family-friendly, allowing staff to shift their schedules as needed, flex their time across the calendar month, and take an hour-long paid break each day (not to mention OFF– see the benefits we provide below).

As an organization, we are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). We invite you to read our DEI statement and principles as well as learn about internal and external DEI initiatives we support here. Read more about our culture here.

Although we are geographically diverse, we are a small, cohesive community dedicated to our mission and to each other.

As an open organization valuing trust and transparency, we have an employee and contractor privacy policy describing how we handle applicant, employee and contractor data that we invite you to review if interested.

We provide:

A family-friendly, flexible working environment, including:

  • Flexible work hours and the ability to work fully from home (when not traveling)
  • A committed and awesome team serving a community-driven organization
  • Competitive compensation & benefits, including a generous annual leave allowance, leave for Family & Compassionate Care, and an ORCID-wide day off on the Fourth Friday of each month
  • A continuous learning environment with opportunities for training & professional development
  • Tools to support our virtual office environment, including a monthly remote working stipend.
  • An annual in-person all staff retreat plus optional virtual social events throughout the year.

Compensation

ORCID’s compensation strategy considers an applicant’s skills and experience, geographic location, as well as internal equity when assessing salary. Because we are remote and hire staff all over the globe, our salary ranges will vary by location for any given role.

The compensation for this role will be $60-$90k USD annually, or local equivalent, depending upon location, skills, and experience.

Salary: $60-$90k USD annually, or local equivalent, depending upon location, skills, and experience

jobs.description:
Cloud Cost Optimization Program Manager

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the role

We are looking for a senior Cloud Cost Optimization Program Manager (FinOps) to support a large-scale cloud optimization program for a Fortune 50 technology organization.

This role sits at the intersection of FinOps, cloud infrastructure, data, and technical program management. You will work directly with Cloud Service Provider (CSP) partners, engineering teams, and senior leadership to identify cloud savings opportunities, drive optimization initiatives through execution, and establish scalable processes for cloud cost governance.

This is not a reporting-only FinOps role. We’re looking for someone who can understand the technical and financial drivers of cloud spend, turn data into actionable initiatives, and influence engineering teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

This opportunity is open to candidates based in the United States and Canada and requires significant overlap with Pacific Time (PST/PDT).

For US-based candidates, this is a W-2 contract opportunity. We are unable to provide current or future employment visa sponsorship for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner directly with AWS and GCP account and technical teams to identify savings opportunities, resolve billing or data issues, and drive optimization commitments through completion.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of cloud cost reduction initiatives across compute, storage, networking, and platform services.

  • Partner with engineering teams to scope, prioritize, and track initiatives such as rightsizing, commitment optimization, architecture changes, and workload migrations.

  • Monitor cloud spend, anomalies, forecasts, and optimization opportunities, proactively identifying risks and areas for improvement.

  • Work with cloud billing, usage, tagging, and allocation data to support cost analysis and savings validation.

  • Prepare financial analyses, business cases, forecasts, and savings reports for senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Translate complex cloud infrastructure and financial data into clear recommendations and decision-making narratives.

  • Own recurring cloud cost governance and reporting cadences across engineering and leadership teams.

  • Improve processes around tagging, forecasting, cost allocation, savings validation, and optimization tracking.

  • Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables across multiple engineering and business teams.

  • Drive execution through influence and strong stakeholder relationships rather than direct authority.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • 14+ years of professional experience, including significant experience leading complex technical programs in large enterprise environments.

  • Strong experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, cloud economics, or cloud financial management.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS and/or GCP, including cloud infrastructure, pricing, billing, usage, and cost optimization concepts.

  • Demonstrated experience driving measurable cloud cost optimization initiatives with engineering or infrastructure teams.

  • Strong Technical Program Management experience across complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives.

  • Experience partnering directly with Cloud Service Providers and/or managing CSP-related technical and cost initiatives.

  • Ability to work with cloud cost and usage data, with working knowledge of SQL, scripting, data pipelines, and/or data modeling.

  • Experience developing financial analyses, forecasts, business cases, savings reporting, and executive-level communications.

  • Proven ability to influence engineering teams and drive delivery without direct management authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Based in the United States or Canada with availability for significant Pacific Time overlap.

  • For US candidates, existing authorization to work in the United States without current or future employment visa sponsorship.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Apptio Cloudability, VMware CloudHealth, or similar FinOps platforms.

  • Experience with AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), GCP Cloud Billing, or equivalent native CSP tooling.

  • FinOps Foundation certification or other formal FinOps training.

  • Experience supporting cloud environments operating at significant enterprise scale.

  • Experience designing or improving tagging, cost allocation, forecasting, anomaly management, or cloud governance processes.

  • Exposure to multi-cloud cost optimization across both AWS and GCP.

Tools and Environment

  • AWS

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

  • Apptio Cloudability / CloudHealth

  • Native CSP billing and cost-management tools

  • SQL and cloud cost/usage datasets

  • Data pipelines and reporting platforms

  • FinOps frameworks and practices

Why This Role is Exciting

You’ll have the opportunity to influence cloud economics at significant enterprise scale, working directly with engineering organizations, CSP partners, and executive stakeholders.

Rather than simply identifying savings opportunities, you’ll help turn them into measurable results — shaping how cloud optimization initiatives are prioritized, executed, measured, and scaled across a complex technology organization.

This role offers substantial ownership and visibility for someone who enjoys combining technical understanding, financial analysis, program leadership, and stakeholder influence.

What we offer

  • Remote opportunity for candidates based in the United States and Canada.

  • For US-based candidates, W-2 contract engagement.

  • Paid time off after the first 3 months of engagement, including applicable local holidays.

  • Long-term opportunity supporting a large-scale global technology organization.

  • Collaboration with senior engineering leaders, cloud specialists, CSP partners, and executive stakeholders.

  • High-impact work with direct, measurable influence on cloud optimization and operational efficiency.

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

There's a category that's been doing things the same way for over a hundred years. We're here to change that.

Most creative directors don't dream about performance marketing. We're looking for the one who does. The one who gets genuinely excited by the question: why did that ad work? This isn't a role for someone who wants to set a vision and step back. It's for the rare CD who thinks in tests, moves fast, loves seeing their work tied directly to real results, and still has the creative ambition to push into territory no one in this category has explored yet.

This role has one core mandate: make our paid social creative breakthrough. You'll have significant ownership over creative strategy and execution across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, UGC, and influencer content, and you'll play a key role in shaping where the creative goes next. This role reports into the VP of Creative & Brand.

  • Own the creative strategy and execution for paid social across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, from concept through production and delivery

  • Stay deeply in tune with what's working across our paid social channels, using performance data as a source of creative inspiration, not just a scorecard
  • Stay current on platform trends, competitor creative, and where the industry is heading — you bring that intelligence back to the team before everyone else catches up
  • Champion AI adoption across the team to accelerate concepting, production, and creative iteration
  • Lead and develop a team of two video editors, two ACDs, and a Senior Designer
  • Build the frameworks and processes that let a lean team produce quality work at volume
  • Manage external production partners and agency relationships as needed

  • 10+ years in creative direction with a strong portfolio of paid social and direct response video creative
  • Deep expertise in performance creative at scale, including UGC, influencer content, and DR formats across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube

  • Proven ability to give feedback that is sharp, fast, and elevating — you make the work better without slowing it down
  • Experimentation mindset: you've worked closely with performance or growth marketing teams on testing frameworks and know how to use data to inspire creative direction without letting it replace creative instinct
  • Experience managing and developing a small creative team including editors, designers, and ACDs
  • AI-native: you're already using AI tools in your workflow across concepting and production and can demonstrate the workflows you've built

Clinical Pharmacist – Cardiology / Value-Based Care

A remote clinical pharmacist role optimizing cardiac medication therapy and titration in partnership with nurses and cardiology providers.

Healthcare — Value-Based Cardiology Care

Care management / clinical leadership (title only — confirm exact reporting line)

Business-hours overlap — CT

$60–$65 USD/hour

Care management platform / EMR

Role Overview

Our client is seeking a full-time, contract Clinical Pharmacist with strong cardiology experience to support value-based care programs. This role focuses on optimizing guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT), supporting medication titration, improving medication adherence, and collaborating closely with nurses and cardiology providers to improve outcomes for high-risk cardiac patients. This is not a dispensing role — the pharmacist functions as a clinical partner embedded within the care team.

Key Responsibilities

Medication Review & GDMT Optimization

  • Review patient medication profiles for cardiology populations — heart failure, coronary artery disease, atrial fibrillation, hypertension, and overlapping chronic conditions such as CKD.
  • Evaluate appropriateness of GDMT based on ACC/AHA guidelines and payer quality programs.
  • Identify gaps in therapy, contraindications, drug interactions, and adherence barriers.
  • Make evidence-based recommendations for medication initiation, optimization, and titration, in collaboration with providers and nursing staff.

Patient Engagement

  • Conduct telephonic medication reviews and patient education.
  • Educate patients on purpose, benefits, side effects, and expectations of cardiac medications.
  • Reinforce adherence and lifestyle considerations; help patients recognize red-flag symptoms.

Care Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with RN Care Managers and Nurse Navigators to align medication plans with care goals.
  • Communicate recommendations clearly to cardiologists and advanced practice providers.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary case reviews and care planning.
  • Document recommendations and patient interactions promptly in the care management platform / EMR.

Quality & Value-Based Care

  • Contribute to performance on medication-related quality measures.
  • Help reduce medication-related adverse events and prevent avoidable utilization.
  • Apply sound clinical judgment within established clinical protocols.

Who Will Succeed

A clinically confident cardiology pharmacist who is comfortable working telephonically, communicates complex clinical information in a patient-friendly way, and thrives inside a nurse-led, interdisciplinary care model.

  • Strong cardiology clinical background and comfort with GDMT decision-making.
  • Confident, professional communicator with cardiology providers and APPs.
  • Patient-centered communication style — clear, empathetic, and clinically accurate.
  • Comfortable in a fully remote, telephonic, non-dispensing clinical role.

  • Strong telephonic patient communication skills
  • Ability to interact professionally and confidently with cardiology providers
  • Experience engaging directly with patients
  • Experience collaborating with physicians and advanced practice providers
  • Time zone compatibility — must be able to work during the client's required business hours - CT
  • Strong written and verbal communication — exceptional written English; assessed at screening

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with ACC and AHA guidelines and payer quality programs
  • Experience documenting in electronic medical records or care management platforms
  • Prior remote or telehealth patient engagement experience

Remote Work Requirements

jobs.excerpt: About the Company: ArcSite is the leading mobile sketching and drawing-based takeoff and estimating solution, trusted by designers, field sales teams, technicians, and inspectors.
jobs.description:
About the Company:

ArcSite is the leading mobile sketching and drawing-based takeoff and estimating solution, trusted by designers, field sales teams, technicians, and inspectors. Our intuitive platform empowers users to create professional drawings on any device—without the steep learning curve of traditional CAD software—helping businesses save time, generate quotes faster, and close deals more efficiently.

We’re a remote-first team with a strong sense of community, driven by growth, collaboration, and our core values: start with the customer, constantly improve, take risks, operate with transparency, and own it. At ArcSite, every team member has the opportunity to grow their career while making an impact, shaping the future of design, and living these values in everything we do.

About the Role:

ArcSite’s product-led growth motion drives roughly half of company revenue and is our largest source of qualified leads. As User Acquisition Manager, PLG, you’ll own user acquisition for our self-serve funnel, with a focus on bringing the right users into the ArcSite product efficiently and at scale.

You’ll lead acquisition strategy across paid channels and App Store Optimization (ASO), managing the channel mix, budget, experimentation, and performance needed to grow self-serve signups and installs. You’ll work closely with Product and Marketing to understand which users and acquisition sources drive the strongest downstream outcomes, using those insights to continuously improve targeting, spend, and channel strategy.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the unique dynamics of self-serve and product-led acquisition and knows how to turn paid and organic channels into a scalable growth engine.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own user acquisition strategy: Develop and execute the acquisition strategy for ArcSite’s PLG motion, identifying opportunities across paid and organic channels to increase qualified self-serve signups and installs.
  • Manage paid acquisition: Own and optimize paid search, social, display, affiliate, and other relevant acquisition channels, with a focus on self-serve users rather than sales-assisted lead generation.
  • Lead ASO strategy: Own App Store Optimization across iOS, Android, and Windows, including keyword strategy, listing optimization, creative testing, ratings and reviews, and regional/international optimization.
  • Manage acquisition budget and channel mix: Allocate and optimize spend across acquisition channels to balance growth, volume, and CAC efficiency.
  • Build and optimize acquisition experiments: Develop a structured testing roadmap across channels, audiences, creative, landing pages, bidding strategies, and store listings to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Measure acquisition quality: Analyze acquisition sources and downstream product behavior to understand which channels, audiences, and campaigns produce the highest-quality users. Use these insights to improve targeting, channel mix, and investment decisions.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Analytics to share acquisition insights, align on growth opportunities, and ensure acquisition strategy supports the broader PLG funnel. Product owns activation and conversion; this role owns getting the right users into the funnel.
  • Own acquisition reporting: Establish and monitor key acquisition metrics including CPI, CPA, CAC, signup volume, channel efficiency, store listing conversion, ASO visibility and rankings, and acquisition-source quality.
  • Stay ahead of acquisition trends: Continuously evaluate emerging channels, platform changes, competitive activity, and new acquisition opportunities relevant to PLG and self-serve SaaS.

Requirements

  • 4–6+ years in user acquisition, growth marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or mobile apps with a self-serve/product-led motion
  • Hands-on experience managing paid acquisition campaigns across search, social, display, and/or affiliate channels
  • Hands-on ASO experience across app store platforms (iOS, Android, and/or Windows), including keyword optimization and regional/international strategy
  • Familiarity with paid bidding platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and ASO/monitoring tools (e.g., Sensor Tower, AppTweak, Storemaven)
  • Working knowledge of product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude) to evaluate the downstream quality of acquired users
  • Comfort with SQL and CAC/funnel-efficiency analysis

Nice to Have

  • Experience acquiring users across multiple platforms, including iOS, Android, Windows, and Web.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, vertical SaaS, mobile applications, or field-service/construction technology.
  • Experience working within a PLG organization where product usage and self-serve conversion are central to the growth model.
  • Experience with ArcSite’s marketing and analytics stack, including HubSpot, GA4, ChartMogul, Ahrefs, ASOlytics, and Mixpanel.

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K match
  • $75 monthly wellness stipend

ArcSite is an equal opportunity employer and fosters an inclusive environment. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, ethnicity, orientation, creed, or other traits. We welcome people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives to apply to our positions.

jobs.description:
Reporting to - Head of Publishing Operations

About Packt

Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e-books, audiobooks, and video courses.

For more details, visit .

Role Overview

As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into. 

The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.  

The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.

This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.

What You Will Do

Technical:

  • Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
  • Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
  • Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
  • Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
  • Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
  • Perform quality checks on code-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
  • Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
  • Support the team to improve code repositories and code-testing systems
  • Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
  • Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
  • Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles 

Editorial:

  • Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
  • Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
  • Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
  • Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
  • Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
  • Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
  • Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
  • Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet

Author/Expert management: 

  • Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
  • Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators

Who You Are

You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.

Must-have skills:

  • Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
  • Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
  • Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
  • Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
  • Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
  • Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders

Good-to-have skills:

  • Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality-control processes and workflows
  • Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced environments

Why Work at Packt

We are a global and remote-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:

  • Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
  • Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
  • Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge-sharing.
  • Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work-life balance.

We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by: 

  • Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives. 
  • Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility. 
  • Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer-to-peer recognition. 
  • Fostering a culture of self-development. 
  • Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged. 

Benefits
You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.

Bonus scheme 

5 day working week

25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)

Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India

Training programs and Certification

Group Medical Insurance

Wellness initiatives

Salary Range - INR 25K - 40K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)

Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.

    • Authenticator applications

  • Proficiency with:

    • eConsent solutions

    • IRT/IWRS platforms

    • Clinical trial technology ecosystems

  • Experience supporting:

jobs.description:
was wir suchen

Die #1 Plattform für Neukunden

Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen wir die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Head of IT (m/w/d) für unser IT Team, zu 100 % aus dem Home-Office (Deutschland) oder bei uns im Bremer Office!

das sind deine aufgaben

  • Du führst unser Tech-Team (aktuell 8 Personen aus Entwicklung, Daten und Infrastruktur) disziplinarisch und fachlich – inklusive 1:1s, Zielvereinbarungen, Weiterentwicklung und Recruiting neuer Teammitglieder.

  • Du übernimmst das operative Tagesgeschäft des CTO: Priorisierung, Ressourcenplanung, Eskalationen und alle Entscheidungen, die heute noch an ihm hängen bleiben.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsetzung unserer Roadmap über alle vier Bereiche hinweg – Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur – und sorgst dafür, dass zugesagte Termine gehalten werden.

  • Du sorgst für planbare Lieferfähigkeit: Du etablierst klare Prozesse für Planung, Entwicklung, Testing und Release und machst den Fortschritt für alle Bereiche im Unternehmen sichtbar.

  • Du baust eine belastbare Datenbasis auf: Du bringst unsere Kennzahlen zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen in eine Form, der Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung vertrauen können.

  • Du verantwortest Stabilität, Security und Skalierbarkeit unserer Plattform – von Monitoring und Incident-Management über Backups und Zugriffsrechte bis zu DSGVO-Themen.

  • Du bleibst technisch nah dran: Du bewertest Architekturentscheidungen, liest Code-Reviews mit und kannst im Zweifel selbst in den Code schauen – auch wenn du nicht mehr die Mehrheit deiner Zeit dort verbringst.

  • Du steuerst technische Schulden aktiv: Du machst sie sichtbar, bewertest sie wirtschaftlich und verhandelst mit den Fachbereichen, wann wir sie abbauen.

  • Du bist der Ansprechpartner der Fachbereiche für alle technischen Themen und übersetzt zwischen Business-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung.

  • Du steuerst externe Dienstleister und Tools, inklusive Auswahl, Verträgen und Budgetverantwortung für den IT-Bereich.

dank deiner expertise erreichst du folgende meilensteine bei uns

  • 0-3 Monate:

    • Du kennst Team, Systemlandschaft, Roadmap und die wichtigsten Stakeholder und hast mit jedem Teammitglied ein 1:1 geführt

    • Du hast eine schriftliche Bestandsaufnahme erstellt: größte Risiken in Stabilität und Security, größte Engpässe in der Lieferfähigkeit, Zustand unserer Datenbasis

    • Du hast die 1:1s, die operative Priorisierung und die täglichen Eskalationen vollständig vom CTO übernommen

    • Gemeinsam mit dem CTO ist schriftlich festgehalten, welche Entscheidungen bei dir liegen und welche bei ihm

  • 4-6 Monate:

    • Fachbereiche wissen jederzeit, woran gearbeitet wird

    • Monitoring, Alerting und ein Incident-Prozess inklusive Post-Mortems sind etabliert; kritische Security- und DSGVO-Lücken aus der Bestandsaufnahme sind geschlossen

    • Eine erste verlässliche Version unseres Kennzahlen-Reportings zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen ist live – mit klar definierten Metriken und benannten Ownern

    • Der CTO wird nur noch bei strategischen Fragen eingebunden, nicht mehr im Tagesgeschäft


  • 7-12 Monate:

    • Die Lieferfähigkeit ist messbar besser als bei deinem Start (z. B. kürzere Durchlaufzeiten, höhere Release-Frequenz, weniger Fehler in Produktion)

    • Ein Plan zum Abbau technischer Schulden läuft und ist mit den Fachbereichen abgestimmt

    • Das Team ist entsprechend der Wachstumsplanung aufgestockt und strukturiert; du hast selbst eingestellt und Verantwortung im Team weiterverteilt

    • Die Plattform trägt das geplante Wachstum ohne Stabilitätsprobleme, und die Datenbasis ist im Unternehmen die anerkannte Wahrheit

das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Führung von Tech-Teams (ab ca. 3 Personen) – als Head of Engineering, Engineering Manager, Teamlead, Head of IT oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Einen soliden technischen Hintergrund als Entwicklerin oder Entwickler (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) – du hast selbst gebaut, was du heute verantwortest

  • Verantwortung über mehrere Disziplinenhinweg: Du hast nicht nur Entwicklung geführt, sondern auch mit Daten und/oder Infrastruktur zu tun gehabt

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur (AWS, GCP oder Azure), CI/CD und modernen Web- und Plattform-Architekturen

  • Ein sicheres Gefühl für Priorisierung: Du kannst begründet Nein sagen und hältst auch dann Kurs, wenn mehrere Bereiche gleichzeitig etwas von dir wollen

  • Erfahrung darin, Prozesse einzuführen, die tatsächlich gelebt werden – ohne das Team in Bürokratie zu ersticken

  • Ein datengetriebener Arbeitsstil: Du misst, bevor du entscheidest, und machst Ergebnisse für andere nachvollziehbar

  • Kommunikationsstärke Richtung Nicht-Techniker: Du kannst Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung erklären, warum etwas dauert – so, dass es verstanden und akzeptiert wird

  • Eigenverantwortung und Umsetzungsstärke: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, sondern erkennst selbst, was zu tun ist

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Start-up, Scale-up oder Agentur) ist ein klarer Pluspunkt

  • Erfahrung mit Lead-Generierung, Performance Marketing oder B2B-SaaS ist ein Bonus, aber keine Voraussetzung

was uns wichtig ist

  • Diese Stelle kann zu 100 % im Home Office erledigt werden. Für Team-Events und Quartalsplanung freuen wir uns über ca. 1–2 Präsenztage pro Quartal in unserem Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt (Reisekosten übernehmen wir).

  • Du berichtest direkt an den CTO und bist Teil des erweiterten Führungskreises.

  • Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle in unbefristeter Anstellung.

  • Diese Rolle ist bewusst breit angelegt: Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur laufen bei dir zusammen.

das bieten wir dir

  • Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld sowie die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam “The Lead Company” aufzubauen.
  • Ein riesiger Markt und zahlreiche interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – wir lösen das größte Problem unserer Partner: die Automatisierung ihrer Neukundengewinnung.
  • Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (remote, im Bremer Headquarter oder nach Absprache auch aus dem Ausland).
  • Volle Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit – du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten individuell mit deinem Team.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr + die Möglichkeit, jederzeit unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen.
  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead‑Rente”).
  • Jährliche Teamevents wie Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier.
  • Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – moderne Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum unterstützen dich bei der täglichen Arbeit.
  • Zuschuss fürs Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E‑Gym Wellpass).
  • Schnelle Entscheidungen – wir sind 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und unabhängig von Investoren.
  • Eine offene Feedback‑Kultur und regelmäßige interne Trainings.
  • Transparente Kommunikation durch monatliche All‑Hands‑Meetings, wöchentlichen Newsletter und feste Team‑Updates.
  • Im Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt erwarten dich ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, großartiger Kaffee & Espresso, Getränke und Grillabende.
  • Für Home‑Office‑Mitarbeitende: monatliche Home‑Office‑Pauschale von 20 €.
  • Bikeleasing, lease dein Wunschfahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen.

das sind unsere werte

  • Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.

  • Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.

  • Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

As a Sr. Lead Substation Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the planning, design, and delivery of utility-scale substation projects. Working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and project managers, you will support projects from concept development through construction while ensuring technical excellence, quality, and client satisfaction.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and building strong client relationships while contributing to the continued growth of AECOM's Energy business.

Technical Leadership

  • Career growth, leadership development, and professional training opportunities.

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.

  • Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).
  • Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.
  • Strong written communication in English — you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.

  • Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.

  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

  • A track record of independently managing 8–12+ concurrent technical requisitions across multiple functions, seniority levels (IC through Director/VP), and geographies.

  • A proven ability to build and run sourcing strategies for senior and hard-to-fill technical roles from scratch.

  • Excellent judgment, organization, and prioritization; comfortable owning your own workload and calendar with minimal oversight.
  • A self-directed, outcomes-first operating style: you diagnose problems, propose solutions, and execute, rather than waiting for detailed direction.

jobs.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
jobs.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

NOCD is looking for independently licensed Mental Health Counselors (LMHC) and Marriage and Family Therapists (LMFT) in New York who are on the pathway to earning their Diagnostic Privilege (Dx P) but have not yet completed the full 2,000 hours of supervised experience required by New York State.

This role is designed for candidates who already qualify for the Diagnostic Privilege in every respect except the completion of supervised hours. NOCD will provide the qualified clinical supervision needed to complete your remaining hours while you build a caseload and gain specialized training in OCD and related disorders with a clear path to full Dx P and independent diagnostic authority.

What You'll Do

  • Provide evidence-based therapy to Members with OCD via the NOCD video platform, under the required clinical supervision toward your Diagnostic Privilege
  • Manage your own caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete, timely clinical documentation in the NOCD EHR
  • Participate in regular supervision sessions focused on diagnosis, psychotherapy, and assessment-based treatment planning — the core competencies required for Dx P
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation and specialized ERP/OCD training
  • Collaborate with NOCD's network of providers to develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements — Diagnostic Privilege Pathway

To be eligible for this role, candidates must qualify for the New York Diagnostic Privilege in all respects, with the sole exception of completing the required supervised experience hours:

  • Full, unrestricted NY license as an LMHC or LMFT
  • At least 1,000 of the 2,000 required hours of supervised direct client contact already completed — experience must include diagnosis, psychotherapy, and the development of assessment-based treatment plans, in a setting acceptable to NYSED
  • Qualifying graduate coursework already completed covering NYSED's four required content areas (diagnosis and assessment-based treatment planning; assessment, evaluation and diagnosis using accepted classification systems; developing and implementing assessment-based treatment plans; and clinical interventions with diverse populations), as reflected on your official transcript
  • Able to secure third-party certification of the above — your graduate program's registrar and a qualified supervisor or licensed colleague must be willing to complete and submit the certification sections of NYSED Forms 2D and 4D on your behalf (see the accompanying one-pager for details)
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required (may be satisfied during pre-licensed supervised experience)
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience treating OCD with ERP preferred but not required

Please note: an offer of employment for this role is contingent upon the accurate and complete submission of the relevant clinical portions of New York State Education Department Forms 2D (Certification of Education) and 4D (Certification of Experience) by your graduate program's registrar and your qualified supervisor or licensed colleague.

What NOCD Provides

  • A qualified clinical supervisor who holds the Diagnostic Privilege in your profession, to supervise and attest to your remaining hours toward the 2,000-hour requirement
  • Support navigating the NYSED application and certification process
  • World-class ERP/OCD-specific clinical training and ongoing consultation
  • Dedicated teams handling marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling
  • 1:1 mentorship for complex cases

Full-Time Provider Expectations

  • 40-hour work week; 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
  • 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
  • 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time
  • Completion of cross-license application process during onboarding
  • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after NOCD's Child & Adolescent training

Who You Are

  • Masters Degree required
  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in New York (LMHC or LMFT)
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner; excellent communicator; strong time management
  • A confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with technology
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
  • Base Salary Comp Range in New York = $70,000 – $95,000
  • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Generous PTO; 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (primary caregiver), 6 weeks (secondary caregiver) for qualifying full-time employees
  • A clear career path, including full independent Diagnostic Privilege upon completion of your remaining supervised hours

Employment for this role is contingent upon accurate completion of the required clinical certification sections of NYSED Forms 2D and 4D; NOCD is unable to guarantee hire based solely on submission of these forms.

jobs.description:
We're looking for someone to own Human Understanding & Adaptive Collaboration as one of wingmaite's four foundational product disciplines. This isn't a traditional product role, you won't simply manage features or execute roadmaps. You'll define how wingmaite understands humans and collaborates with them, building the discipline through which experts externalize knowledge that only they currently hold.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Enterprise Knowledge Elicitation: Define how wingmaite interviews experts, asks follow-up questions, reconstructs decisions and surfaces tacit knowledge
  • Adaptive Collaboration: Decide when the system should ask, explain, interrupt, remind, wait, or deliberately not infer
  • Collaboration Conditions: Model the situation, not the person: authority, expertise, timing, necessary friction
  • Human Understanding Integrity: Establish what the product may legitimately learn about a person in context, and what it must deliberately leave unmodeled
  • Challenge the CPO, CTO and Engineers on questions inside your pillar as one of four intellectual owners at the company
  • Turn deep thinking into product behavior that's measurable and useful
  • Build toward a small team, starting as a strong individual contributor

What this role is explicitly not

HR tech. Employee analytics. Performance management. Personality profiling. Engagement optimization. Prompt engineering. Traditional UX research. wingmaite models conditions, not characteristics. No scoring people, no manipulating behavior, no inferring personality, no replacing human judgment.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Background in AI product, human-computer interaction, cognitive science, knowledge engineering, learning sciences, human factors, behavioral design, or enterprise software
  • Exceptional product judgment and experimental thinking
  • Think in situations, decisions, authority, expertise, and conditions, not fixed user traits
  • Real ethical restraint: You know when a system should not infer something, even if it could
  • Ability to turn deep thinking into measurable product behavior
  • Fluent English (C1–C2)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience building early-stage products or working in startup environments
  • Prior work with technical or expert users
  • Familiarity with enterprise software contexts
  • Hands-on mindset and technical skills that help you prepare prototypes and realize smaller features on your own

Who you are

  • You start with the decision someone's facing, their authority and expertise, not their personality traits
  • You can hold complex thinking and translate it into clear product decisions
  • You have real restraint about what systems should and shouldn't do
  • You take full responsibility for your discipline and its outcomes
  • You work closely with leadership, engineering, and customers to shape the product
  • You thrive on creating new disciplines, not executing existing ones

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Flexible remote setup
  • Learning & development opportunities
  • Generous vacation & workation budget
  • The opportunity to define one of four foundational product disciplines at wingmaite

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter explaining how you think about this question:

How must wingmaite understand a human and work with them so the collaboration is effective, appropriate, and legitimate?

Optional: include examples of product work!
